scripts.up: pnpm setup && pnpm build && pnpm start
scripts.up:terminal: pnpm setup && pnpm build && pnpm start:terminal
scripts.up:landing: pnpm setup && pnpm build && pnpm start:landing
scripts.cf:build: bun run iac:gen && cd apps/web && MODE=landing LANDING_ONLY=1 opennextjs-cloudflare build --config ../../infra/wrangler/landing.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare populateCache local --config ../../infra/wrangler/landing.jsonc
scripts.cf:types: bun run iac:gen && wrangler types --config infra/wrangler/landing.jsonc infra/types/cloudflare-env.d.ts
